name: pos_transactions
description: This table stores point-of-sale transaction details. It captures data related to purchases, including payment information and transaction timestamps. The table tracks the location where each transaction occurred. It also records the status of each transaction. This data supports sales analysis and reporting.

name: supplier_master
description: This table stores information about suppliers. It serves as a central repository for supplier-related data. The table facilitates supplier management and analysis. It supports reporting on supplier locations and contact information.

name: pos_transaction_items
description: This table stores granular data about items sold within each point-of-sale transaction. It captures details about the products sold, their quantities, and their corresponding prices. The data allows for detailed analysis of sales at the individual item level. This enables insights into product performance within transactions.

name: product_master
description: This table stores comprehensive product information. It serves as a central repository for product attributes. The table includes details about product categorization, physical dimensions, pricing, and stock management. It supports product analysis and inventory control.

name: product_suppliers
description: This table tracks the relationships between products and the entities that supply them. It identifies the specific suppliers for each product. The table also categorizes the nature or role of each supplier. This data is useful for understanding product sourcing strategies. It supports analysis of the supplier ecosystem.

name: location_master
description: This table stores a comprehensive list of locations. It serves as a central repository for location-specific details. The data includes addresses, contact numbers, and location types. This information is useful for managing and referencing various locations.

name: customer_master
description: This table stores customer information. It serves as a central repository for customer data. The table includes contact details and location information. It is used for customer relationship management. It supports analysis of customer demographics.
